correctness.rationale: Orthogonality gives ||ρ||²=||Eρ||²+||R||² and <ρ,σ>=<Eρ,Eσ>+<R,S>. The missing purity coordinates therefore become the Euclidean norms of (a,R) and (b,S), and the whole change of G is the product of these norms minus their inner product. Cauchy–Schwarz proves the direction and shows equality precisely for parallel nonzero vectors in the same direction or if either vector is zero (including pure fixed states). Pinching is positive, trace preserving, idempotent and Hilbert–Schmidt self-adjoint by cyclicity and P_i P_j=δ_ij P_i. This proves the claims and handles trivial projections and both pure inputs without a continuity assumption. The frozen VERIFICATION.md contains analytic evidence only, consistent with the proof; no computation or outside certification is needed.
